ambiguities.text: The phrase 'from the first block of the fork onward' for EL parameter activation is ambiguous about edge cases during fork transition.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume parameters apply starting with the first block whose number >= PRAGUE_FORK_BLOCK, and parent block parameters are used for parent-dependent calculations.

ambiguities.text: The statement 'monitoring indicates that we have a stable network' does not define quantitative stability metrics.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume stability refers to acceptable re-org rates and block propagation times as measured by client team monitoring dashboards.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes network bandwidth and node hardware can handle 50% more blob data per block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Solo stakers with limited bandwidth may fall behind, increasing centralization pressure.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes IDONTWANT message implementation provides sufficient bandwidth savings to offset increased blob load.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could experience increased propagation latency and higher re-org rates.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes L2 rollups will use the increased capacity responsibly without gaming the fee market.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Aggressive L2s could monopolize blob space, pricing out smaller users.

implicit_assumptions.description: Assumes the asymmetric fee adjustment (8.2% up vs 14.5% down) maintains appropriate equilibrium pricing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Blob fees could become too volatile or converge to unintended price levels.
